interpretation.cloudtrail: Account-observed launch evidence is workload- and retry-correlated, not a controlled market sample.
interpretation.placement_score: Partition-pool directional signal on a 1-10 scale. It is not a guarantee or a per-type score, and this collection uses AWS's capacity-optimized scoring assumption while the templates use price-capacity-optimized.
interpretation.price_history: Spot price history is market-price evidence, not proof of launch capacity.
